comment: The steps of the transition program (generators/transition/), run in order by tools/generators/run.sh. Each step reads json-patch-tests tests.json and walks its cases as one history: a case that states an expected document is a transition from its document by its patch, chained to the transition before it. transitions and transitionsmore write the acceptance vectors of the snapshot guest's transition request (cases 1 to 36, and the rest): the W3C PROV record the case must give, whose addresses are those of the case's own document, patch and expected document; 'the state does not change' where the expected document is the document; 'the patch does not apply' where the case states an error. provtransitions and provtransitionsmore write the same records as acceptance vectors of the PROV-CONSTRAINTS checker (guest prov), each to be answered valid. GenPatch, GenJcs and Sha256 are the modules of generators/snapshot, byte for byte. jsonsuitesums writes the SHA256SUMS of the JSONTestSuite files held under app/specs/oracle/json-test-suite, one request per file. refusalcase writes, for one of those files, the acceptance vector of the snapshot guest's canonical request over the file's text, to be answered 'not I-JSON'; refusals, refusalsmore and refusalsijson gather them: the files the suite says a parser must refuse (n_, in two halves), and the lone surrogates, overflowing numbers and duplicated names that RFC 8785 requires refused.
